verdict.rationale: First-party chat docs say users can choose "Start voice chat" to talk with the Bot live, which directly covers a real-time voice conversation. The support rests on one brief documentation line, so naturalness and real-time quality are unverified. Missing for 10: detail on voice latency, interruption/turn-taking and supported platforms (desktop vs. mobile), plus any hands-on or community corroboration of conversation quality.
